Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Federal Reserve Board calendar lists FOMC minutes for the Oct 27-28 meeting on Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET and the December 8-9 policy meeting on Dec 9 at 2:00 PM ET, followed by the press conference at 2:30 PM. No November FOMC policy decision appears on the checked Board calendar.
  • Veterans Day is listed by the Board for Wed Nov 11; it states daily and weekly statistical releases scheduled for that day move to Thu Nov 12. The natural gas report is shifted to Fri Nov 13 at 10:30 AM ET per EIA's schedule.
  • Funding and conditions are lagged: SOFR 3.92% effective Nov 5, NFCI -0.459 for the week ending Oct 30, MOVE 92.77 on Nov 6, and the official 10-year Treasury close 4.86% on Nov 6.
  • The high-sensitivity near-term release is CPI Tue Nov 10 at 8:30 AM ET. The later BEA schedule confirms GDP (Second Estimate) and Personal Income and Outlays for October both on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM ET; the NY Fed calendar separately lists PCE on that date.
Omissions and Watch
  • Calendar cutoff: all displayed timed rows are strictly later than Mon Nov 9, 12:30:38 AM ET. Checked calendars show today's remaining verified rows and the selected week-ahead items shown above; elapsed Employment Situation and other past releases are excluded. November 11 holiday is retained as a date-only item because the Board gives no time.
  • Conflict check: NY Fed and BEA both place GDP Second Estimate and Personal Income/PCE on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM. BEA gives October 2026 for Personal Income and Outlays and Q3 2026 for GDP; the NY Fed entry leaves the period unstated. No conflict remains on the release date. CPI is listed separately from PPI.
  • Source limits: BLS.gov was not requested; the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar is the date/time source for BLS releases. The NAR Existing Home Sales date/time is confirmed on the New York Fed calendar; the NAR schedule page returned no date-specific entry in this fetch. The Philadelphia Fed date/time likewise is confirmed on the New York Fed calendar; its linked schedule did not return a matching date-specific line.
  • EIA's petroleum schedule moves the report for data through Nov 6 to Thu Nov 12 at noon; its stated standard day/time applies for unlisted weeks. EIA's natural gas schedule explicitly shifts Veterans Day to Fri Nov 13 at 10:30 AM.
  • Unmatched classifier events (Wholesale Trade, Federal Reserve Veterans Day holiday, Initial Claims, Imports and Exports, and Industrial Production) are provisional Medium and flagged in their rows for review. The impact self-test passed; no overrides used. CPI is High and PPI is Medium.
  • Selected calendar rows only; routine releases, some auctions and other scheduled items are not exhaustive. No verified watch item from this run for unscheduled geopolitical or policy risks; this is not a full headline-risk review. Check fresh event notices, liquidity and contract specifications before execution.

Market snapshot is single-source vendor data, not official settlement.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Cautious, event-sensitive two-way risk: ES=F is up 0.46% in early Monday trading and the latest SPY close gained 0.31%; VIX eased to 25.64 and MOVE is 92.77 in the moderate-uncertainty band. The official 10-year yield rose 2 bp to 4.86%. Monday's calendar has Wholesale Trade and the Survey of Consumer Expectations before the 3-year auction; CPI is Tuesday at 8:30 AM ET. Avoid treating a quiet overnight move as confirmation; watch price, rates and breadth around the release. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if CPI or rates sharply reprices policy expectations, volatility expands against the overnight move, or ES moves without confirmation from rates, breadth or depth. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify the intended contract, current event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
